exposure: Cause of postpartum hemorrhage (atonic PPH, placental site bleeding)
Uterine balloon tamponade using a condom catheter
cohort: 50 women with early postpartum hemorrhage who were unresponsive to uterotonics and bimanual compression
finding: Uterine balloon tamponade using a condom catheter was found to be an effective method for controlling early postpartum hemorrhage.
